title: Making a supermarket POS work offline
summary: Why billing should never stop when the internet drops — and how syncing works.
body:
## Why offline matters

In a busy store, a dropped connection can't stop checkout.

## How it works

1. Bills are saved on the device while offline.
2. When the connection returns, pending bills sync to the server.
3. A stock ledger records every sale, return and delivery so all counters stay consistent.
